notes.note: Corrects this round's generic note. Re-read for the #4003 verifier round: the work-claims section says a Session dispatched for a Task in that Project stamps the Task id on its claims, and lists taskId? on claims. Before this round that never happened live, because the binding's Project (the Task's slug) was compared to the claim scope (the opaque id) as strings; session-work-claims.ts now resolves both through localProjectIdFor, so the statement holds, and a binding in another Project still stamps nothing. The runtime-routes and station-runtime changes only pass that lookup.
